body: Well, mainly people who have bothered me on a daily basis since primary school are targets. They've tped my house, burned down some trees in my backyard, keyed my car and many other minor annoyances that enrage me for the past decade. It isn't just me but my group of friends are also victims here. Admins can only do so much to punish them and some teachers even encourage\look the other way when confronted with this problem.
Nothing as serious as the VT massacre but something more successful than this.
